title: Pikachu Went to Space!
summary:
Pikachu has been to space! On September 19, 2026, the European Space Agency, or ESA, shared that a Pikachu plush toy spent 67 days on the International Space Station.

The toy blasted off on April 11 on a Cygnus cargo spacecraft. It came back to Earth on June 17 on a SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft. While in space, Pikachu circled Earth about 1,040 times!

The trip was planned to kick off World Space Week, which runs from October 4 to 10. ESA made a special exhibit that mixes real space science with Pokémon. It started in Paris, France, and will visit places across Europe until April 2027.

Pokémon GO players can join in too. At some science and space museums in Europe, they can try special raids with Astronaut Pikachu.

"Inspiring future generations is a key part of ESA's mission," said ESA leader Josef Aschbacher.
why_it_matters: Fun characters like Pikachu can make learning about space exciting for kids.
